stemMd: What is the solution set of x² > 9?
explanationMd: The inequality is |x| > 3, so x must be farther than three units from zero. This gives two exterior intervals. Both negative and positive branches matter, and equality is excluded.

distractorRationale.c: That interval makes x² less than nine.
distractorRationale.e: Negative values below −3 also have squares greater than nine.
distractorRationale.b: The strict inequality excludes the endpoints.
distractorRationale.a: Values near zero do not satisfy the inequality.
